title: CORS Best Practices
description: Secure CORS configuration patterns and common pitfalls.

data.text:
**CORS Best Practices**

Follow these patterns for secure and maintainable CORS configuration.

items: Whitelist specific origins, never use wildcards
Limit allowed methods to only what you need

data.text:
Development: Allow localhost origins
Staging: Allow staging domain
Production: Allow only production domains
Never allow all origins in production

items: Forgetting to enable CORS in production

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Good CORS configuration balances security with functionality.
